review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; prospective design self-review
review.decision: Retain withdrawal owed by a late platform acceptance and cover unobservable old-process callbacks
review.notes: Review #1930 v4 timing before implementation. Use fake delivered inventory, explicit Main Queue barriers, and a fake polling clock. Verify that cleanup never sends another add or hides live notice B.

cases.description: A late platform success under unknown state keeps cleanup owed
cases.setup: A pending system add for A; B already delivered. Publish a verified snapshot that resolves A and run cleanup before A appears in system inventory.
cases.action: Make the snapshot unreadable, let A's success callback arrive, and restore identical verified bytes.
cases.expected: The unknown callback cannot revoke B or lose the cleanup obligation. A is withdrawn once after recovery and no new add occurs.

cases.description: Bounded desktop housekeeping catches a late system notification after process restart
cases.setup: A new manager verifies a resolved A with only B visible. Inject a fake system-delivered A after that cleanup, without any observable old-process callback.
cases.action: Poll with unchanged authoritative bytes before and then at the minute boundary.
cases.expected: No rapid additional cleanup loop. The bounded next sweep removes stale A, keeps B and does not post again.
